messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or live data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. You can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone, or a smart assistant to get the up‑to‑date time.
message.reasoning: User asks: "What is the time now in New York City?" We need to provide current time. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate using UTC offset. But we need to be careful: New York City is Eastern Time (UTC-5 standard, UTC-4 daylight). Today is 2026-05-31. Daylight Saving Time likely in effect (DST ends early November). So offset is UTC-4. We need current UTC time. We don't have that. We could say "I don't have real-time data." But maybe we can approximate using system time? We don't have system time. We can respond that we cannot provide real-time. But we can instruct user to check. According to policy, we should not fabricate. So answer: "I don't have real-time capability."
